body: 7 Nov 2026, the day in short. NOT marked after that: nothing of the fixes below is merged (the checks cannot run, P0-16) and none is walked on a release-candidate pair, so every one of them is "built" at most. ADDED to the board: P0-16 (owner: make GitHub's checks run again) and proposals N-10 to N-15. Open pull requests: #241 to #246; build 144 on the owner's A35 is a local merge of them. The owner's rules of the day: do not jump from one problem to another, and find causes, not symptoms.
